translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Chunca jipashcunaman tincusiypa Jesucristo yachasishgan
Cutimuptin imano cananpä cashgantapis tantyasishpanmi Jesús nergan: “Chunca (10) jipashcunashi farolnincunata alistacurcur shuyacog aywayargan casaracog magta
shamuptin paywan fiestaman aywayänanpä.
Shuyacog aywarshi pisga cag jipashcuna aceitinta
apayargan farolnincunaman yapayänanpä. Pisga cag jipashcunanashi isanga aceitinta apayargansu.
Casarag magta mana chaptinshi shuyaraycäyashgalancho lapan punucäcuyargan.
“Sayno punucash caycäyaptinshi pulan pagas hörano gayacamushgan wiyacämorgan: ‘¡Casaracog magta shamuycannami!’ nir.
Sayno gayacamushganta wiyarshi lapan jipashcuna jucla sharcuyargan payta chasquicuyänanpä.
Saychömi farolnincunaman yapayänanpä aceitita mana apag jipashcuna waquin cag jipashcunata niyargan: ‘Farolnë upicaycannami. Aceitiquita raquipaycayälämay farolnëcunaman winayänäpä.’
Sayno niyaptinmi aceiti apag jipashcuna niyargan: ‘Raquipäyaptëga manami aypäyämangasu quiquëcunapäpis. Saypa trucanga aceiti ranticogcunaman aywar jucla rantiyämuy.’
Aceiti ranteg aywayashganyagshi casarag magta chämorgan. Listu shuyaraycagcunatashi fiestaman yaycasergan. Fiestaman yaycurirnashi puncuta wichgacarcamorgan.
Aceitita ranteg aywayashganpita cutirnashi tariyargan puncu wichgaraycagta. Sayshi gayacuyargan: ‘¡Puncuta quichapaycayälämay, taytay!’ nir.
Sayno gayacuyaptinshi casaracog magta ruripita contestamorgan: ‘Gamcunataga manami reguësu. ¿Pirä cacuyanquipis?’ nir.”
Sayno yacharcasir Jesús nergan: “¡Gamcunapis alistacushla caycäyay! Nogaga elagpitami cutimushä. Manami musyayanquisu imay junag ni imay höra cutimunäpä cashgantapis.”
Ashmaynincuna aruyänanpä patronnin guellayta puestupashgan
Saypitanami Jesús nergan: “Juc rïcu runashi juc nacionpa aywacur ashmaynincunata guellayninta cachapargan cutimushganyag say guellaywan aruyänanpä.

Habilidänincuna imano cashgantapis shumag tantyaycurshi jucninta cachapargan pisga waranga (5,000) guellayta, jucninta ishcay waranga (2,000) guellayta y jucnintanashi cachapargan juc waranga (1,000) guellayta. Nircurshi carupa aywacorgan.
Pisga waranga guellayta chasqueg cäga shumag negociuta rurarshi pisga waranga masta gänargan.
Ishcay waranga guellayta chasqueg cagpis saynölashi shumag negociuta rurar ishcay waranga masta gänargan.
Juc waranga guellayta chasqueg cagshi isanga pañuëluwan shumag guepiycur pampaycunä.
“Saypitanashi say ashmaycunapa patronnin cutimur puestupashgan guellaynincunata cuentata manargan aycata guellaynin wachashgantapis.

Sayno cuentata manaptinshi pisga waranga guellayta chasqueg cäga pisga waranga masta entregargan. Sayshi say ashmay nergan: ‘Pisga waranga guellayta cachapämashgayquiwan pisga waranga mastami gänashcä, taytay.’

Sayno niptinshi patronnin nergan: ‘Gamga ali ashmaymi canqui. Walcalapitapis shumag guellayta mirasishgayquipitami cananga más mandag canayquipä churashayqui. Sayno cashgayquipita cananga cushicur fiestata rurashun.’
“Saynölashi chargan ishcay waranga guellayta chasqueg cagpis: ‘Taytay, ishcay waranga guellayta cachapämashgayquiwan ishcay waranga mastami gänashcä’ nir.

Sayno niptinshi patronnin nergan: ‘Gampis ali arog ashmaymi canqui. Walcalapitapis shumag guellayta mirasishgayquipitami cananga más mandag canayquipä churashayqui. Sayno cashgayquipita cananga cushicur fiestata rurashun.’
“Saynölashi juc waranga guellayta chasqueg ashmayninpis chaycur nergan: ‘Noga musyämi fiyu cashgayquita, taytay. Gamga mana murushgayquimanmi cosechag aywanqui.
Sayno fiyu cashgayquita musyarmi gamta mansacur guellayniquita pampaycorgä. Saymi gayasimaptiqui cashgalanta guellayniquita apamushcä.’

Sayno niptinshi patronnin nergan: ‘¡Gamga mana yäracuypä guela ashmaymi canqui! Mana murushgäpita cosechag cashgäta musyaycarga ¿imanirtä guellaynëta banculamanpis churargayquisu mirashtana cutimur shuntacunäpä?’
Nircurnashi saycho caycag runacunata patrón nergan: ‘¡Guechuyay sararaycashgan guellaynëta! ¡Nircur goycuyay chunca (10) cuti más guellay miraseg cagta!
Guellayta puestupashgäta mirasegcunaga mastami chasquiyanga. Mana mirasegcunami isanga sararashgalantapis guechushga cayanga.
Sayno captenga cay mana ali ashmayta sacayman garguyay. Saychömi fiyupa wagar quiruntapis uchongapä.’
Juicio finalcho imano cananpä cashganpita Jesucristo yachasishgan
“Lapan angilnëcunawan cutimurmi chipipiycag trönöman noga jamacushä lapan runacunata juzganäpä.
Say junäga may-say nacionpitami lapan runacunata angilnëcunawan shuntasimushä. Sayno shuntarcasimurnami raquishäpä uysha miseg uyshancunata cabracunapita raquishganno.
Saychömi mana chasquicamag runacunata raquishä isognë cagman y chasquicamag runacunatana derëchä cagman.

Sayno raquircurnami derëchächo caycagcunata nishä: ‘Gamcunataga Tayta Dios segaypami cuyayäshunqui. Naupäman shayämuy lapan puestushgäcunata chasquiyänayquipä. Saytaga Tayta Diosninsi gamcunapä puestush cay pasata manarä camarmi.
Gamcunami micanaycar puriptë pachä garayämashcanqui. Saynöpis yacunaycar puriptë upunäpä yacuta goyämashcanqui. Saynölami wayiquiman chämuptëpis posädasiyämashcanqui.
Mödanaynag captëpis gamcunami jaticunäpä mödanata puestupäyämashcanqui. Gueshyaptëpis gamcunami jampiyämashcanqui. Carcilcho captëpis gamcunami watucayämashcanqui.’
“Sayno niptëmi say runacuna tapuyämangapä: ‘Taytay, ¿imaytä micanar puriycagta garayashcä? Saynöpis ¿imaytä yacunar puriycagta upunayquipä yacuta goyashcä?
Saynöpis ¿imaytä wayëman chämushcanqui posädasiyänäpä? Saynöpis ¿imaytä mödanaynag caycaptiqui jaticunayquipä mödanata puestupäyashcä?
Saynöpis ¿imaytä gueshyaptiqui o carcilcho captiqui watucag shayämushcä?’
Sayno nimaptinmi nishä: ‘Yäracamagcunata mayganpis yanapag cagcuna nogata yanapämagnömi cayashcanqui.’
“Nircurmi isognëcho caycag runacunata nishä: ‘¡Gamcunataga Satanaspä y supaycunapä camarish caycag infiernumanmi canan gaycushayqui imayyagpis saycho rupar nacayänayquipä!
Gamcunaga micanaycar puriptëpis manami garayämashcanquisu. Saynöla yacunaycar puriptëpis manami upunäpä yacuta goyämashcanquisu.
Saynölami wayiquiman chämuptëpis posädasiyämashcanquisu. Mödanaynag caycaptëpis manami jaticunäpä mödanata puestupäyämashcanquisu. Gueshyaptëpis carcilcho wichgaraptëpis manami watucayämashcanquisu.’

“Sayno niptëmi isognëcho cag runacunapis tapuyämanga: ‘¿Imaytä gam micanaycagta, yacunaycagta, wayëman chaycämogta, mödanaynagta, gueshyaycagta, carcilcho wichgaraycagta ricaycar yanapäyashcäsu, taytay?’
Saymi paycunata nishä: ‘Nacaycho cagcunata mana cuyapar nogatami cuyapäyämashcanquisu.’ ”
Sayno wilaparcushpan Jesús nergan: “Say mana cuyapäcog runacunaga infiernuchömi imayyagpis nacayangapä. Tayta Dios munashganno yanapäcog runacunami isanga imayyagpis gloriacho cawayangapä.”

footnotes.text: -4 Say wisan kerosëni manami carganräsu. Saymi olïvu jachapa wayuyninpita rurash aceitiwan acsicuyag.
